assignments.reason: The concept of 'being included in the air of the Land of Israel' is essentially about the holy atmosphere (אוירא דארץ ישראל) which the Torah explicitly equates with הבל שאין בו חטא (sinless breath). Both of these are already in Package 1. The essential nature of this node is the holy, pure breath of Eretz Yisrael — the soul-light domain. It appears as the effect of צדקה דארץ ישראל (edge 1354), but its nature IS the holy air, not the charity that produces it.

The revelation of the Patriarchs in the world is the ultimate manifestation of divine holy protection. The Torah states that through the children's sinless breath (הבל שאין בו חטא, Package 1) and the air of the Land of Israel (אוירא דארץ ישראל, Package 1), the Patriarchs are revealed to protect the world. The Patriarchs (Abraham, Isaac, Jacob) represent the roots of the holy soul — 'ויקרא בהם שמי ושם אבותי.' Their essential nature is the foundational expression of divine soul-light and holy memory (זכרון), placing them squarely in the נפש/תורה domain.

assignments.node_id: להכניע החמר, הינו בחינות מיתה, בחינת סכלות של הגוף של הארבע יסודות
assignments.reason: This node describes the material-body domain being subdued: חמר (matter), מיתה (death), סכלות (folly), גוף (body), ארבע יסודות (four elements). Every concept named in this compound node is already in Package 2 or assigned to it in additions. The essential nature of this node IS the body/matter/darkness domain — it is the evil that is weakened by fasting. While the subduing action is positive, the node itself describes and names the evil-domain concepts. It is the effect of תענית (edge 1579), but its nature is חמר/גוף, not תענית.

Meriting Torah wisdom (חכמות התורה) is essentially about Torah wisdom itself. חכמות התורה is already in Package 1. This node describes the attainment of that very concept. The Torah's concluding verse interpretation states: 'ועזו — הינו על ידי התורה... ועל ידי מה תזכה לחכמות התורה, בקשו פניו תמיד — על ידי צדקה של ארץ ישראל.' The essential nature is Torah wisdom, not the charity that leads to it.

assignments.node_id: תכלל עצמך באוירא דארץ־ ישראל, שהוא בחינות הבל הקדוש שאין בו חטא
assignments.reason: This node describes including oneself in the holy air of Eretz Yisrael, explicitly equated with הבל הקדוש שאין בו חטא (the holy sinless breath). Both אוירא דארץ ישראל and הבל שאין בו חטא are already in Package 1. The essential nature of this concept is the holy breath/atmosphere — the pure, sinless, soul-light domain. It is caused by צדקה דארץ ישראל (edge 3127) but its nature IS the holy air, not the charity.
